title: Queued mailbox dispatch can strand a session in Active with no runtime and an unstoppable LIVE TURN
outcome:
Observed by Greg (2026-08-30): with a mailbox message queued behind an active turn, Stop misbehaves — LIVE TURN keeps spinning forever and nothing happens; Stop appears dead. Distinct from tm-pukb (silent paused queue) and tm-yq2d (work keeps running): here the session is stranded in Active with no live turn and Stop is physically impossible.

Diagnosed mechanism (read-only, code on 796aa90):
1. NO ROLLBACK AFTER FAILED DELIVERY: turn-end paths dispatch the next queued prompt by committing status=Active + appending the prompt message FIRST (dispatch_next_queued_turn), then calling deliver_turn_dispatch (turn_lifecycle.rs ~:746-752 and the three sibling sites ~:913/:1043/:1232). A delivery error only propagates into a log line; the started turn is never rolled back, so the session stays Active forever with nothing running. (The stop path already has the correct pattern: post_stop_record rollback in session_lifecycle ~:684-709.)
2. SHARED-CODEX PROMPT FAILURES CAN VANISH: handle_shared_codex_prompt_command_result (codex.rs ~:2092-2111) reports failures via fail_turn_if_runtime_matches guarded by the writer runtime token. If Stop just cleared/replaced the session runtime the token no longer matches and the failure is silently dropped; if a stop is in flight the callback defers, and the stop transition then does deferred_stop_callbacks.clear() (session_lifecycle ~:584, turn_lifecycle ~:498), discarding the deferred failure instead of replaying it.
3. STOP 409s IN THE STRANDED STATE: with status=Active and runtime=SessionRuntime::None, stop_session returns 409 'session is not currently running' (session_lifecycle ~:375-377), so the user cannot recover from the UI.
4. INTERRUPT NO-OP RACE: SharedCodexSessionHandle::interrupt_turn returns Ok when state.turn_id is still None (session_runtime.rs ~:220-222) — a Stop racing a just-dispatched turn 'succeeds' without interrupting anything.

Suggested fix order (smallest first):
(c) stop_session on Active+runtime=None must close the turn (fail_turn 'runtime lost') instead of 409 — restores UI recovery on its own;
(a) roll back the started turn when deliver_turn_dispatch fails at the four turn_lifecycle sites (reuse the post_stop_record pattern), requeueing the mailbox notification like record_rejected_turn_dispatch does;
(b) stop discarding deferred_stop_callbacks in stop transitions — replay them after the claim is released;
(d) turn-start watchdog for shared Codex: prompt sent but no turn-started event within a deadline => fail_turn (also covers events lost to a detached thread mapping).

Methodology per tm-oixt: tests-first reproduction of both interleavings (deliver failure after queued dispatch at natural turn end; stop racing the queued dispatch with the deferred-callback discard) before the fix. Related: tm-pukb, tm-oixt, tm-yq2d.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. Stop and mailbox recovery were hardened in 7f6052c (ancestor of master f7db2c58). Closed by evidence.
